# evroc_role_binding (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing project-scoped IAM role binding.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role binding to look up.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project the role binding belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the role binding was created (RFC3339 format).
- `display_name` (String) Human-friendly display name for the binding.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `principal` (String) Principal FQID.
- `roles` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--roles))
- `uid` (String) System-assigned unique identifier (UUID).
- `user_labels` (Map of String)

<a id="nestedatt--roles"></a>
### Nested Schema for `roles`

Read-Only:

- `resources` (List of String)
- `role` (String)
